apps.name: Restring Helper
apps.versionDescription:
# Restring Helper — Full Changelog

---

## Web Orders Integration
- **Dedicated Web Orders View** — A brand new, fully integrated page to track unfulfilled Shopify restring orders.
- **Smart Dispatch Tabs** — Orders are automatically categorized into "Send Today", "Send Tomorrow", "Pickup", and "All" using a strict 2:00 PM cutoff rule (including weekend logic).
- **Auto-Refresh** — The Web Orders page now automatically pulls fresh data from the server every 10 minutes in the background, complete with a live-ticking "Last checked: X mins ago" indicator.
- **Dashboard UI Parity** — The Web Orders page layout, segmented picker, and order cards have been styled to be 100% identical to the main Dashboard.
- **Order Card Enhancements** — Phone numbers are now formatted perfectly (e.g., +44 79226 51621) and are directly tappable to initiate a call/message. Product variant details (like grip size) are now explicitly displayed alongside the racket model. Order-level customer notes and stencil requirements ("Stencil: Yes/No") are cleanly extracted from the checkout and highlighted. Order numbers are displayed cleanly (e.g., #40381 instead of #40,381).

---

## Stringer Credit System
- **Team Roster** — You can now configure your stringing team roster directly in Settings.
- **Attribution Popup** — Completing an order on either the Dashboard or the Web Orders page now prompts a "Who strung this racket?" modal to give credit.
- **Analytics Leaderboard** — A new "Stringer Leaderboard" sits at the top of the Analytics page, tracking exactly how many rackets each person has strung.
- **Secure Reset** — Added a new "Reset Web Orders History" button in Settings to clear the local web orders log and reset the leaderboard credits when needed.

---

## Quality of Life & UI Polish
- **Undo Toast** — Added a 5-second "Undo" toast that appears at the bottom of the screen after marking any order as complete, allowing you to instantly revert accidental taps.
- **iPad Multitasking** — Enabled native iPadOS Multitasking! You can now use the app in Split View or Slide Over alongside Safari, Shopify, or Messages.
- **App Icon Badges** — The app icon on your home screen now dynamically displays a red badge with the number of orders due today and tomorrow.
- **Faster Workflow** — Removed the redundant "Mark Order as Done?" confirmation alert to speed up rapid checkoffs.
- **Empty States** — The "No Orders" placeholder text dynamically updates to reflect exactly which tab you are looking at.

---

## Editing & Workflow Toggles
- **Free Restring Toggle** — Added a new toggle when creating orders that automatically locks the string selection to "Wilson Sensation - FREE".
- **New Racket Toggle** — Added a "New Racket" toggle that automatically hides pricing from the dashboard and printed labels when selected.
- **Unsaved Changes Protection** — The app now intercepts the "Cancel" button when editing an order and warns you if you have unsaved changes.
- **Order Context Menu** — Restored the "Select" button to the order long-press context menu on the Dashboard.

---

## Printer & ZPL Label Tweaks
- **Note Wrapping** — ZPL labels now unconditionally print notes. If a complex hybrid string job physically pushes the note off the label bounds, a * (star) indicator will be printed so you know to check the iPad.
- **Persistent Connection** — The Zebra printer now keeps its connection active immediately after a successful print rather than instantly disconnecting, dramatically speeding up back-to-back printing.

---

## Backend & Shopify Sync
- **Crash Prevention** — Overhauled backend API parsing to safely handle null properties, guest checkouts, and missing customer data from Shopify without crashing (HTTP 500 fixes).
- **Auto-Cancellation** — If an order is untoggled from "Paid" or deleted locally in the app, the backend will now automatically cancel the corresponding draft order on Shopify.
- **Intelligent Customer Merge** — The backend now automatically deduplicates customers by name and recursively merges missing contact information when syncing to Shopify.
- **Accurate Filtering** — Improved backend web order extraction to properly ignore rackets marked as "No Restring Required" by the customer.
apps.localizedDescription: An application to help with stringing sports racquets and printing labels with Zebra printers.
